v2.0.2 Update
- Sale end-time and automatic-restock settings now follow the active calendar's hours per day and minutes per hour. On a 30-hour calendar, a saved 25:00 restock stays at 25:00.
- Restock intervals and duration calculations use custom calendar units, including external calendars read through Smartphone Widget.
- Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.1.

announcement.title: 🛍️ Stylish Shop v2.0.2
announcement.content:
Stylish Shop v2.0.2 fixes sale and restock times for custom calendars.

  • Sale end-time and automatic-restock settings follow the calendar's hours per day and minutes per hour. A 30-hour calendar accepts times through 29:59, and saving 25:00 no longer changes it to 23:00.
  • Restock intervals follow the calendar's day length, including external calendars read through Smartphone Widget. The Foundry calendar fallback also uses custom time units.
  • Update GlitchSmith Library to 0.13.1 or later.
